title: Silver Surfer AromaTop
description:
Enjoy sweet aromas from your Silver Surfer Vaporizer with the AromaTop by 7th Floor Vapes.
The Silver Surfer Vaporizer is a very versatile vaporizer. And the AromaTop adds another layer to that.
The AromaTop sits on top of the Silver Surfer for use with wax melts or other aromatic oils. The Silver Surfer can also be used as usual while the AromaTop is in use.
Included
1 x Silver Surfer AromaTop
3 x Wax Melt Sample
